_comment: Persistent trend/ability memory for the self-improve skill. Managed by .claude/skills/self-improve/SKILL.md — read that before editing. Statuses: watch | proposed | active | rejected | retired | retire-recommended | dropped.

abilities.notes: Passed small favorites lose money counterfactually (would-have-bet the final pre-slate snapshot). Pass-pool trend: no CLV, so per SKILL.md it can only ever propose a paper-mode ability. Interpretation if it persists: the engine's pass decisions on small favs are correct — a possible framing is validation of the current threshold rather than a change. Not Bonferroni-significant this run (p=0.0383 raw, 87 cells tested).

Book-dispersion lens added 2026-08-02. Treated as ONE trend with the corroborating ml-passes|dispersion_bucket=very wide (0.6pp+) cell (26-36, -23.8% ROI, t=-2.06), which also cleared the bar the same run: passes lose counterfactually whenever books disagree by 0.25pp+, and lose harder the wider the disagreement. The flip side is the actual hypothesis of interest: TIGHT-dispersion passes (<0.25pp) were counterfactually +10.3% over 177 settled (t=1.46, did not clear the bar). Mechanism candidate: when books agree tightly, the consensus price is efficient and our best-price EV is honest; when they disagree, the stored EV is inflated by soft-book outliers. Pass pool: no CLV, paper-mode ceiling per SKILL.md. Not Bonferroni-significant (118 cells).
